name: absent-keys-are-written-null
reference: spec/engine-spec.md 0.56 `null`: no line writes a value at label, q or s (s1 and s2 both absent), so each is written null at its field-line position. The order for an absent key is default, then first exact sentinel, then null: x has `default probe.x 7` and writes 7; code has `absent N/A` and writes the string "N/A" (ruling 11 of 0.5: not number text). The list is absent and writes nothing (0.7). Derived by hand.
